rateLimits.note: The stricter form the schema can say. Shopify's real rule for the Admin GraphQL API is cost-based: a leaky bucket of query cost points restored at 100 points a second on the standard plans (200 Advanced, 1,000 Plus, 2,000 Commerce Components), each query at most 1,000 points, the bucket's state in every answer (extensions.cost.throttleStatus), which the provider's client reads and waits on. Two requests a second is the REST Admin API's leak rate on the standard plans.

provenance.notes: Limits per app and store. Not expressible in the schema: cost points per query (computed by Shopify per query and plan). Per store with 500,000 variants or more, 10,000 new variants a day (outside Shopify Plus); input arrays of 250 items at most; pagination up to 25,000 objects. Shopify documents no idempotency for draftOrderCreate: the provider never retries a mutation.
